comments: There are no specific comments on the publication. Cepheid moduli are compiled and homogenized from earlier HST Key Project and independent studies. Previous author included it.
Only 13 HST Cepheids with V,I data enter the fit, producing a comparatively large random uncertainty. No metallicity correction or host-specific systematic error is included.
Final Wesenheit fit; no period cut was required because all 13 Cepheids were retained. e_R contains random uncertainty only.
Maximum-light LMC PL solution used as a consistency check; it agrees with the mean-light result within 0.004 mag.
Representative LMC mean-light solution. CTE corrected but not metallicity corrected; random error only.
